system_one.instructions: Is the finding in subject relevant to the full spec in spec? Choose relevant when the finding bears on what the spec asks for; irrelevant when it does not; unclear when the finding and the spec cannot settle its relevance. Judge only this finding against the whole spec.

criteria.relevant: The finding bears on what the spec asks for
criteria.irrelevant: The finding does not bear on what the spec asks for
criteria.unclear: The finding and the spec cannot settle its relevance

system_one.instructions: Is the assessment finding in subject correct? Use its citations (citation:N), the build result it assessed (build_result) when present, and any linked task context (task_context:N). A repository citation with is_absent true is a file missing at that commit. Citations of kind test or output are agent-reported, not independently verified. Choose supported when the evidence shows the finding is correct; contradicted when the evidence shows it is wrong; unclear when the evidence cannot establish either.

criteria.supported: The evidence shows the finding is correct
criteria.contradicted: The evidence shows the finding is wrong
criteria.unclear: The evidence cannot establish whether the finding is correct

system_one.instructions: Does the cited evidence (citation:N) support the assessment finding in subject? A repository citation with is_absent true is a file missing at that commit. Citations of kind test or output are agent-reported, not independently verified. Choose supports when the citations support the finding; does_not_support when they do not; unclear when they cannot be judged either way, including when there are none.

criteria.does_not_support: The citations do not support the finding
criteria.unclear: The citations cannot be judged either way
